summary: Every course must be letter graded. You take the seven core film production courses in sequence (FILMPROD 405, 406 and 407 also make up the thesis film), FILMEDIA 410 and 411, the three companion production courses, one Studio Art course (4 units), two Film and Media Studies courses (8 units) and one choice elective of at least 4 units, for 56 units. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA each quarter, and a B- or below in a core course or elective means academic probation. The companion courses FILMPROD 410, 411 and 413 may be taken in either of two orders, and all three are required either way.
